title: Migrate from fetch to HTTP library/axios
body: # Feature Request ## Description of Problem: Mocking 'fetch' within Jest is hard and has introduced some awkward issues with libraries such as fetch-mock. @rocketstack-matt has proposed a migration here #945 but we may be able to totally avoid this by just removing raw use of 'fetch' from the CLI. # Potential Solutions: Suggested solution is to use `axios` which is a lot easier to mock, since it isn't a global 'magic' function and instead creates an instance that can be mocked out.
